messages:
Aisha: Tiny poll: if our office had a mascot, what should it be? options: \ud83d\udc3f Overcaffeinated Squirrel, \ud83d\udcce Zen Stapler, \ud83e\udde0 Rolling Whiteboard, or \ud83d\udfe8 Eternal Post-It. pick 1-emoji and one-liner.
Ben: Overcaffeinated Squirrel. energy levels off the charts. :coffee: :laughing:
Carlos: Rolling Whiteboard. runs away mid-presentation. iconic. :face_with_monocle:
Dana: Eternal Post-It. clings to your calendar and your soul. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Ellen: Zen Stapler. calm, decisive, slightly menacing. :lotus:
Aisha: One-liners time. hit me with the catchphrase. 1 line only.
Ben: "Fuel, then ship."
Carlos: "I roll so you don't have to."
Dana: "Stick to it."
Ellen: "Quietly aligning chaos."
SnackBot: Heads-up: kombucha at 30% in the fridge. refill contributions appreciated. :bento_box:
Aisha: React with the emoji for your pick. I'll tally.
Ben: reacts with :thumbsup: (for \ud83d\udc3f)
Carlos: reacts with :rolled_up_newspaper: (for \ud83e\udde0)
Dana: reacts with :pushpin: (for \ud83d\udfe8)
Ellen: reacts with :bookmark_tabs: (for \ud83d\udcce)
Aisha: Non-scientific eyeball count: squirrel wins. New unofficial mascot: Overcaffeinated Squirrel.
Ben: Naming suggestions?
Carlos: "Latency" 12 tiny, jittery, always asking for more tokens.
Dana: I volunteer to smuggle a plushie into reception.
Ellen: Motion to put a tiny squirrel plush above the printer. seconded.
SnackBot: Automated ticket created: `#office-mascot-procurement`. ETA: when Facilities wakes up. :memo:
